card.name: Just before the word fatal
card.fires_on: The word or piece right before an expected "fatal", such as "non" in "fatal and non-fatal", "F" in "F-ATAL", or "sometimes" before "fatal". It fires in warnings about serious or deadly outcomes.

modes.label: non before -fatal
modes.description: The word "non" after "fatal and" or "fatal or", just before "-fatal".

modes.label: Start of fatal
modes.description: The first letter of "fatal" when it is split, in warnings about severe reactions.
modes.example: SERIOUS AND SOMETIMES<< F>>ATAL DERMATOLOGIC REA

modes.label: Modifier before fatal
modes.description: An adverb like "sometimes" placed just before "fatal" in a description of illness.
modes.example: may help treat or prevent the<< sometimes>> fatal lung infections of CF patients.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward "dead" and "death" forms, so the text goes on to a fatal or deadly outcome.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "fatal" in warnings about deadly outcomes.
